about: Fonts a document may ask for that their publisher offers for download at no charge, and the publisher's own download page. WordCraft links to the page; it never downloads, bundles or redistributes the fonts, and the user is responsible for the publisher's licence terms. 'family' also covers every name that continues it after a space: 'Aptos' covers 'Aptos Display'. 'restricted': true marks a font whose publisher limits who may use it or what for; the app then says so beside the download.

downloads.note: Microsoft Download Center, 'Microsoft Aptos Fonts': the whole Aptos family.
Microsoft's own repository; SIL Open Font License.
